description: Allowlisted projection of local command records, TRX inventories and package/binary metadata. Not a CI or full-build success report.
evidencePolicy: Only command text with repo-relative paths, original UTC timestamps, exit codes, method identifiers/counts, numeric native WAV metadata, package versions/assets and hashes. No raw TRX/logs, hostnames, settings, ACL identities, audio, credentials or environment dump.

environment.settingsAndTemp: New task-owned directories inside isolated worktree. No real user settings or credentials.
environment.restore: Session-only official NuGet v2 config, used after missing assets. No global configuration or audit/TLS change.
